upstream.description: Open-source framework for conversational voice AI agents

classification.analysis: TEN Framework is an open-source real-time multimodal conversational AI framework for building voice/video agents that combine ASR, LLM, and TTS extensions (STT/LLM/TTS pluggable via a visual TMAN Designer) with low-latency RTC and WebSocket transport. It ships ready-made agent examples (multi-purpose voice assistant, lip-sync avatars with Live2D/HeyGen/Tavus, speaker diarization, SIP phone calls, live transcription, ESP32 hardware integration) and a broader ecosystem including TEN VAD and TEN Turn Detection for full-duplex dialogue. Implemented across Python, C/C++, TypeScript, Rust and Go, deployable via Docker or Codespaces, and targeted at developers building production voice AI assistants, avatars, and telephony bots.

use_cases.title: Build a low-latency real-time voice assistant with pluggable STT/LLM/TTS
Create a lip-synced avatar agent using Live2D or HeyGen
Add phone call support to an AI agent via SIP
Run real-time speaker diarization for a multi-party voice application
